items.title: Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability in Google Brotli (Broccoli2Shell/HTTP2Shell/Node2Shell)
items.summary: An unchecked return value vulnerability in Google Brotli could allow a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt memory, disclose sensitive information, cause a denial-of-service, or potentially execute arbitrary code. This vulnerability has been added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: BlockStrap: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (RCE)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution through template engine injection. Adobe released a fix in APSB26-153, but a manual patch is required, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (RCE)
items.summary: This critical zero-day vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows unauthenticated remote code execution and was actively exploited in the wild before Adobe released an emergency hotfix (APSB26-146). Attackers can inject malicious PHP code through the template engine's 'styles' property.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability leading to Privilege Escalation
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another account and escalate privileges. Threat actors have been observed attempting to exploit this vulnerability in the wild.

items.title: PolyShell: Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type (RCE)
items.summary: This critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source allows for arbitrary code execution due to unrestricted file upload with dangerous types. CISA added this flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on October 27, 2026, citing active exploitation.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution. This issue was addressed in APSB26-138.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: Another critical stored cross-site scripting vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could result in arbitrary code execution. This was patched as part of APSB26-138.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) leading to Arbitrary Code Execution
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could lead to arbitrary code execution in Adobe Commerce. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization leading to Security Feature Bypass
items.summary: This high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges for exploitation.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization
items.summary: A high-severity incorrect authorization vulnerability was addressed in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source as part of APSB26-153.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability was resolved in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source with the release of APSB26-153.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS)
items.summary: This high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source was patched in APSB26-153.

items.title: Improper Input Validation
items.summary: A high-severity improper input validation vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source was addressed in the APSB26-153 security update.
